Message:
drm/i915: pass dev_priv explicitly to TRANS_SET_CONTEXT_LATENCY

Avoid the implicit dev_priv local variable use, and pass dev_priv
explicitly to the TRANS_SET_CONTEXT_LATENCY register macro.
